key_derivation: Discovery is a single glob, so the set is exactly determined. cake.cs:144 (and 163, 239) is `GetFiles("./test/**/*{Tests,Specs}.csproj")`; `ls test/*/*.csproj` lists seven projects, of which exactly five match: Polly.Core.Tests, Polly.Extensions.Tests, Polly.RateLimiting.Tests, Polly.Testing.Tests, Polly.Specs. The two non-matches are accounted for elsewhere — Polly.AotTest is published trimmed at cake.cs:124-139 and Polly.TestUtils is ProjectType=Library (test/Polly.TestUtils/Polly.TestUtils.csproj:5), a shared helper library. Thresholds come from cake.cs:429-448 reading <Threshold>/<Threshol
